displayName: PauseGuard: live site or API down

documentation.content: An uptime check on the PauseGuard Hosting page or the API's `/health` is failing from at least two regions. `/health` answers 503 when Firestore, BigQuery or Gemini is unreachable; its body says which (`curl -s $API/health | jq`). Runbook: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md §7. Check the latest Cloud Run revision and its logs; run `make smoke`.
